description: Selvaag Bolig ASA, a housing development company, engages in the development, construction, and sale of residential properties in Greater Oslo, Rest of Norway, and internationally. The company operates through Property Development and Other segments. It also offers project management services, as well as engages in rental services. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway. Selvaag Bolig ASA operates as a subsidiary of Selvaag AS.
